svg.title: Residual GPP change (observed minus the change that the weather fit of the control pairs gives) of each fertilisation episode, per site, with the 10 to 90 % range of the control residuals of the site.
svg.desc: Dot plot. X axis: residual of the daily GPP change, observed minus expected (g C m-2 d-1). Y axis: episodes grouped by site, labelled with the start date. Haltiala 5 episodes, control residuals 10 to 90 % from −4.73 to 6.43; Qvidja 4 episodes, control residuals 10 to 90 % from −1.63 to 1.97; Viikki 5 episodes, control residuals 10 to 90 % from −1.10 to 3.54. Mean residual of all 14 episodes −2.30 (SD 4.37, 95 % CI −4.63 to −0.18); fertilisation only −0.14 (n = 5); with tillage or sowing −3.51 (n = 9). 2 episodes rank above 90 % and 6 below 10 % of the control residuals of their site. 6 of the 14 residuals are inside the 10 to 90 % range of the control residuals of their site; 7 of the 9 episodes with tillage or sowing have a residual of zero or less.
